target.summary: When an expect test produces trailing output, output_for_all_clflags emits only the string literal without the enclosing [%%expect ...] extension node. Consequently, the generated .corrected file contains malformed trailing output that is not wrapped in an expect block.
notes: call site printing trailing output without enclosing expect extension node
definition of output_for_all_clflags which does not wrap output in an expect extension node
